scope: Desktop frontend mock workflow and proposed backend contracts only. No production backend or historical document acceptance.
user_final_acceptance: pending_for_this_engineering_stage; earlier user acceptance applied only to isolated local prototype

original_first.reference: Hand-authored non-historical 4-column demo reference, visually inspected before candidates.
original_first.content_verdict: not_a_completed_content_repair; test deliberately adds a column and one note only, keeping 1 unresolved issue. No assertion of historical truth or complete transcription.
original_first.preserved: Initial 6 rows, numbers 12/8,18/5,24/3,25/4 and existing merged spans retained; unchanged Markdown before and after table remains exact by browser assertion.
normalizations: Edited HTML cells gain paragraph wrappers and explicit rowspan/colspan=1.
Whitespace within the touched table block may be normalized; untouched blocks preserved.

typecheck_and_build.warning: Single client bundle about 911 kB minified / 285 kB gzip; code splitting deferred for this local desktop first slice.

red_green_evidence: Draft restoration test failed against unimplemented adapter, then passed without replacing adopted text.
Preview/commit/history test failed against missing operations, then passed with immutable content and idempotent receipts.
Queue capabilities/filter test failed before implementation, then passed.
HTTP contract test failed against stub, then passed; invalid JSON and network errors never use fixtures.
Markdown block preservation test failed before parser implementation, then passed including CRLF and uncommon Unicode.
In-flight typing test failed against missing flush behavior, then passed with serialized newer draft.
Browser regression caught unwanted trailing paragraph after table; disabling automatic trailingNode made it pass.
Consumed-preview regression demonstrated version-1 reuse could adopt an old preview; invalidating previews on new draft made it pass.
visual_findings: Three independent scrolling panels and accessible save controls fit both desktop viewports without horizontal page overflow.
Mock mode, browser-only storage and unconnected downstream services remain visible.
Preview distinguishes save-only from adopt and visibly preserves unresolved issues.
Missing evidence is shown as unbound; HTTP outage is shown as error, without mock fallback.
Candidate test is intentionally incomplete against the reference; unresolved status is retained and not counted as content approval.
known_limits: Backend HTTP routes are proposed and have not been integrated.
Mock storage is browser-local and single-tab oriented; no true server persistence or cross-tab atomicity.
Irregular/unsupported HTML tables use source editing rather than silent normalization.
No production document authenticity/DeepSeek review, source coordinate binding, card structured editing or downstream task orchestration.
History recovery copies Markdown content into a new draft; it does not automatically reapply historical issue decisions.
Current undo/redo is scoped to the active rich-text block.
